-- Phase 2: bodies for shuffled. The order depends only on seed; no capabilities.

-- Advances the generator state to the next pseudo-random value.
next_state(s: int) -> int =
  pre s >= 0
  post out >= 0
  ex next_state(3) == next_state(3)
  let t = s % 2147483648
  (t * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

-- Returns a shuffled copy of xs. The same xs and seed always give the same order.
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre seed >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 1) == []
  ex shuffled([1, 2, 3], 7) == shuffled([1, 2, 3], 7)
  var rest: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    rest.append(x)
  var result: List[int] = []
  var st = seed
  while rest.len() > 0
    st = next_state(st)
    var j = st % rest.len()
    var picked = rest[j]
    var keep: List[int] = []
    var k = 0
    for y in rest
      if k != j
        keep.append(y)
      k += 1
    result.append(picked)
    rest = keep
  result

test_shuffled_keeps_elements() =
  assert shuffled([1, 2, 3], 7).len() == 3

test_shuffled_empty() =
  assert shuffled([], 5) == []

test_shuffled_deterministic() =
  assert shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 42) == shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 42)
